versions.changelog:
fingerprint-failure-triage 1.0.0 – Initial release.

- Reads liarjs fingerprint reports and attributes each failing check to the responsible component.
- Explains what each check id measures and clarifies the origin of the signal (launch configuration, page-modifying layer, network path, or machine image).
- Highlights which failures are expected in headless or datacenter environments.
- Provides clear procedures to interpret, group, and triage results for effective ownership and follow-up.
